## Highlights since 0.16.3

- **Papers added through Lattice pass Check citations.** Add papers now runs the same lookup as Check citations, so it finds published versions known only to DBLP (ICLR, ICML, TMLR), Springer ECCV chapters and CVF paper pages. CVPR and ICCV pages from IEEE or CVF both count as correct. When the NeurIPS or ICLR proceedings sites can't be reached, the row is marked "official verification incomplete" instead of proposing changes, and an official link is never swapped for arXiv. Fixes are grouped into published version, formatting and sources differ, and Apply fixes leaves "sources differ" alone. Re-adding a paper you already cite offers Refresh entry.
- **A stuck TeX run is stopped.** A build that makes no progress for 300 seconds, or repeats the same output for 120 seconds, is stopped and reports where it stood. Auto-build then waits for your next edit. Thanks to @Paivel.

## Notable fixes

- Figure and `\input` paths are resolved the way TeX does: no false "Missing figure" for `./` or `../` paths, and no stale copy picked from another folder. Thanks to @ajay-mk.
- Groundwork for an experimental Windows build. There is no Windows download in this release. Thanks to @LucasDavidTPE.
